toml:
# Gravity-turn ascent losses of an ILLUSTRATIVE two-stage kerosene/oxygen launcher (no real
# vehicle): vertical rise to 1 km, a 3 deg pitch kick for 10 s, then thrust along the
# velocity. The run integrates the gravity, drag, steering and back-pressure losses and checks
# that ideal dv minus the losses equals the burnout speed. MODELLED: planar, non-rotating
# Earth, constant C_D, no coast, no guidance beyond the kick.
kind = "ascent-losses"
payload_kg = 10000.0
drag_coefficient = 0.3
reference_area_m2 = 10.5
kick_altitude_m = 1000.0
kick_angle_deg = 3.0
kick_duration_s = 10.0
step_s = 0.1

[[stages]]
dry_mass_kg = 25000.0
propellant_kg = 400000.0
thrust_vac_n = 7600000.0
isp_vac_s = 311.0
exit_area_m2 = 6.0

[[stages]]
dry_mass_kg = 4000.0
propellant_kg = 100000.0
thrust_vac_n = 980000.0
isp_vac_s = 348.0
exit_area_m2 = 0.0
